title: Run a measured MAP kickoff-alignment practice scenario
description: Exercise MAP from a project kickoff through an implementation-ready brief without changing product code or policy. Use a realistic coordination-surface scenario, distinct visible participant roles, durable kickoff material, and measured friction so the system can improve based on evidence rather than ceremony.
acceptance_criteria: The durable kickoff records the project purpose, success condition, scope/non-goals, known facts, assumptions, risks, roles, authority boundaries, and initial questions before participant recommendations are integrated.

At least two visible non-owner participant roles contribute independently through bounded durable assignments, and the coordinator records convergences, disagreements, and decisions without treating suggestions as policy.
The scenario reports measured or directly counted kickoff efficiency signals: retrieval paths, durable artifacts consulted, participant turns, time/order evidence, and friction/rework observed.
The final brief is implementation-ready enough to create a later task but makes no UI, policy, or authority change; it recommends only evidence-backed follow-up.
